name: Chen's Empty Keg
label: Quest
description: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn turns to another recipe shared by Chen Stormstout. Trogg ale calls for rare organs and glands from beasts of the Barrens.

clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn turns to another recipe shared by Chen Stormstout. Trogg ale calls for rare organs and glands from beasts of the Barrens.

After helping Brewmaster Drohn recreate Chen Stormstout's first draught, you learn the wandering pandaren shared more than one brewing secret. Drohn has the formula for trogg ale, a strange brew made not from grain, but from potent parts of the wild beasts of central Kalimdor.

To make trogg ale, Drohn needs lightning glands from stormhides, a thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a hearty liver from the plains' roaming kodos. Once distilled, these ingredients make a fiercely stimulating drink for life in the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have another recipe that I learned from Chen. Would you be interested? It won't take long to make, and it might be useful if you plan on adventuring some more.
Bring me 5 lightning glands from any stormhide, 1 thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a kodo liver from any of the Barrens' kodos.
Like I said, this stuff has kick; it's the trogg brew that I mentioned to you before.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You working hard at finding those ingredients, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! I knew you couldn't resist some of this brew. Come back again anytime you want some more, friend. Just bring me more of the ingredients I had you collect.
